prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1307; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the rear-end collision described in the enclosed claim materials. Please direct all future communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, email, or mail. If our client has already been contacted, please let us know so that we may address any statements previously given.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a certified copy of the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. This information is needed to evaluate the claim properly.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, adjuster notes, recorded statements, repair estimates, and the claim file in its entirety. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal procedures that might affect these materials.

Please confirm receipt of this letter and your willingness to comply with these requests within fifteen days.
